name: ignore-recorded-requirements
description: a requirement is checked without the requirements already recorded on the module (#L1096-L1104 removed)
old: pub open spec fn base(g: Inp, s: Rs, q: Req, v: nat) -> bool { q.range.contains(v) && rec_ok(s, q.name, v) && inst_ok(g, s, q.name, v) }
new: pub open spec fn base(g: Inp, s: Rs, q: Req, v: nat) -> bool { q.range.contains(v) && inst_ok(g, s, q.name, v) }

name: ignore-installed-requirements
description: installed modules' requirements are not applied (#L1106-L1121 removed)
old: pub open spec fn base(g: Inp, s: Rs, q: Req, v: nat) -> bool { q.range.contains(v) && rec_ok(s, q.name, v) && inst_ok(g, s, q.name, v) }
new: pub open spec fn base(g: Inp, s: Rs, q: Req, v: nat) -> bool { q.range.contains(v) && rec_ok(s, q.name, v) }

name: no-downgrade-floor
description: the '>=installed' bound is not added (#L1148-L1154 removed)

new: pub open spec fn cand(g: Inp, s: Rs, q: Req, v: nat) -> bool { base(g, s, q, v) }
